set -euo pipefail; expected=950076ace1d41b10dfdd7a20e494e03e976a5339; actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo HEAD=$actual; test "$actual" = "$expected"; port=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; test -e "$port"; source scripts/source_idf.sh >/tmp/growbox-eink-bootlog-idf.log 2>&1; esptool.py --port "$port" chip_id >/tmp/growbox-eink-bootlog-chip.log 2>&1; python - "$port" >/tmp/growbox-eink-uart.log <<'PY'
import serial
import sys
import time
port = sys.argv[1]
ser = serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=0.25)
end = time.monotonic() + 45.0
chunks = []
while time.monotonic() < end:
    data = ser.read(4096)
    if data:
        chunks.append(data)
ser.close()
sys.stdout.buffer.write(b''.join(chunks))
PY
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/growbox-eink-uart.log')
text = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
print(text[-24000:])
required = ['eink_requested=1 eink_ready=1', 'outputs=fake-locked']
for token in required:
    if token not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'missing required boot token: {token}')
for bad in ['Guru Meditation Error', 'panic abort', 'Task watchdog got triggered', 'rst:0x8 (TG1WDT_SYS_RST)']:
    if bad in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'unsafe runtime token observed: {bad}')
PY
